opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, including strategic initiatives. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage (nature and habitats, historic buildings and environments, cultures, traditions and memories). No deadline; open all year round.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million

amount.raw: grants from £250,000 to £10m (over £10m for truly exceptional projects)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10m. Requires an Expression of Interest, then a two-phase application (development phase up to two years, delivery phase up to five years). Quarterly application deadlines.
